name: Quake III Arena (VQ3)

scale.why: player hull 56 u tall (MINS_Z -24, maxs 32: bg_public.h#L49, bg_pmove.c#L1293), scaled to 1.8 m: 0.03214 m/u

ground_accel.note: Quake accelerate factor, same formula as Quark's

air_accel.note: VQ3 air: accel 1 toward the full wish speed (no 30 u cap), the strafe-jump that the 'strafe angle' trick exploits. Same formula as Quark's (accel x min(wish, cap)); Quark multiplies air_accel by 10, so 1 -> 0.1. (x0.0455 is outside the editor's 0.1..5 range: applying it clamps.)

air_cap.note: the wish speed the air push aims at

hook_max.source: https://github.com/id-Software/Quake-III-Arena/blob/master/code/game/bg_pmove.c#L672-680 (PM_GrappleMove: velocity set to 800 u/s toward the hook, 10 x distance inside 100 u)
hook_max.note: the pull SETS your velocity (no acceleration, momentum not kept); the grapple is a CTF / mod weapon, not in standard play

grapple.note: the grappling hook exists in the code but isn't placed in standard maps / modes

jumpHeight.note: v^2/2g (higher at 125 fps from rounding in the original client); Quark: 1.22 m

timeTo90.source: derived from this file's speed, ground_accel, friction, stop_speed
timeTo90.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 0.072 s

stopDistance.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopDistance.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 1.21 m

stopTime.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopTime.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 0.364 s

extras: strafe jumping / circle jumping (air accel 1 toward 320 u/s)
no auto-hop in vanilla (jump must be re-pressed)
notes: These pm_* constants are the 'Quake engine cvars' (pm_accelerate 10, pm_airaccelerate 1, pm_friction 6, pm_stopspeed 100, g_gravity 800, jump 270, step 18). Xonotic's Q3 port uses sv_gravity 750.
